{{Quote|Die and be reborn!|Krannus preparing to engage the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Krannus''' was a rare non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]<ref name="Krannus Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Executor Krannus (Knight)}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood Sith]] who served as a [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Due to lacking a connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Krannus was in danger of being left to [[Death/Legends|die]] by his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Parent/Legends|parents]]. He was spared this fate by direct order of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. Although Krannus was considered inferior to Force-wielding Sith, his heritage raised him above the ordinary [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the Imperial Military.<ref name="Krannus Codex" />

Krannus served as one of the Empire's highest ranks–[[Executor (Sith Empire rank)|Executor]]–and wielded his supreme authority as a fiercely-devoted servant of the Emperor who spared his life. On his dark master's orders, Krannus led a [[Krannus's death cult|death-worshipping cult]] whose members believed the Emperor was a godlike being who will bestow [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] and unlimited power upon them if they brought about [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] destruction.<ref name="Krannus Codex" />

To achieve this goal, Krannus went to [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in order to destroy the whole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to start the Emperor's ritual, but was [[Mission to Belsavis (Emperor's ritual crisis)|stopped]] and killed by the [[Hero of Tython]].
